title: Chiba hit by record rainfall with widespread flooding and thousands affected
summary: The level 5 special alert was downgraded to level 4, while the storm leaves four dead, one missing, and forces the deployment of the Self-Defense Forces to move about 4,000 affected people.

title: Russia rejects Japan's protest over Putin's visit to the Kuril Islands; U.S. backs Tokyo
summary: The Japanese prime minister called Putin's visit to Etorofu unacceptable; Moscow responded with harsh criticism and Washington stated that the northern islands are sovereign territory of Japan.

title: Wall Street rebounds and Nikkei rises to 69,000 points after wholesale inflation data
summary: The rise in wholesale prices was lower than expected, curbing expectations of further rate hikes and boosting stock markets.

title: Ten years after the Kumamoto earthquake, reconstruction advances in infrastructure, housing, and heritage
summary: The Kyushu expressway fully reopens, temporary housing is promoted in affected areas, and 234 damages to cultural properties are recorded.

title: The arrangement of neural connections is key to preserving long-term memory
summary: An OIST study with hibernating mice reveals that the pattern of synapses matters more than their strength.

title: Yokohama mayor cries, apologizes, and rules out resigning over workplace harassment
summary: The mayor, whose conduct was deemed workplace harassment, repeatedly apologized before the council but refused to resign.

title: Toshiko Takagi, author of 'The Glass Rabbit', a work about war, dies
summary: The writer, who captured the experiences of the bombings in her children's novel, leaves a legacy for peace.

title: U.S. will impose an additional 100% tariff on drones to boost domestic production
summary: The measure, scheduled for September, includes relief for Japanese manufacturers.

title: Yen weakens and hovers around 159 yen per dollar
summary: The Japanese currency remains under pressure due to interest rate differentials and geopolitical uncertainty in the Middle East.

title: Tension increases between U.S. and Iran in the Middle East over the Strait of Hormuz
summary: Iran maintains a defiant stance on maritime transit, while the U.S. reports drone losses and rotates an aircraft carrier in the region.
